text: 中国证监会首席律师、法制司司长程合红在2026金融街论坛年会“护航普惠包容金融新生态”主题论坛上表示，要强化系统观念，及时对专项金融法律进行配套修改完善。他指出，目前金融领域除了金融法在制定之外，同时金融稳定法、人民银行法、商业银行法、银行业监督管理法等法律的修改制定也已经列入了全国人大的立法议程。证监会正在开展证券法实施效果评估，并推进证券投资基金法修改工作。
text_en: Cheng Hehong, Chief Lawyer and Director-General of the Legal Affairs Department of the CSRC, said at the "Safeguarding an Inclusive New Financial Ecosystem" thematic forum of the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that systemic thinking should be strengthened and supporting revisions and improvements to specialized financial laws should be made in a timely manner. He noted that in addition to the ongoing formulation of the Financial Law, the revision and enactment of laws including the Financial Stability Law, the PBOC Law, the Commercial Bank Law, and the Banking Supervision and Administration Law have also been placed on the NPC's legislative agenda. The CSRC is carrying out an assessment of the implementation effects of the Securities Law and advancing the revision of the Securities Investment Fund Law.
